system.name: Klotski
system.one_liner: an MoE inference engine that reduces pipeline bubbles via an expert-aware multi-batch pipeline

components.name: VRAM
components.role: GPU memory tier holding placed tensors

components.name: DRAM
components.role: CPU memory tier holding placed tensors

components.name: Disk
components.role: disk memory tier holding placed tensors

components.name: Constraint-Sensitive IO-Comp. Planner

content.key_idea: Klotski aggregates heterogeneous GPU/CPU/disk memory offline, then online orchestrates expert loading and computation order across multiple batches so IO and compute overlap and pipeline bubbles shrink.

evidence: We show the system overview of Klotski in Figure 6.
aggregate heterogeneous memory from GPU, CPU, and disk for model deployment
constraint-sensitive I/O-compute planner formulates a pipeline plan

summary: Klotski is an MoE inference engine that overlaps expert loading with computation to cut pipeline bubbles caused by offloading experts across GPU, CPU, and disk memory. Figure 6 gives the system overview as two side-by-side phases: an offline phase where an Adaptive Tensor Placement module allocates MoE model tensors across VRAM/DRAM/disk, and an online phase where incoming request batches are handed to a Constraint-Sensitive IO-Compute Planner that produces a pipeline plan, aided by a Correlation-Aware Expert Prefetcher. Both feed an Execution Pipeline, expanded below as parallel IO Thread and Inference Thread timelines. Circled numbers mark the flow order, and blue/purple/yellow blocks distinguish expert, gate, and attention layer computations throughout the diagram.
summary_zh: 图6展示Klotski系统架构：离线阶段将MoE张量分配到GPU/CPU/磁盘异构内存，在线阶段请求批次经IO-计算规划器和相关性预取器生成流水线计划，驱动下方IO线程与推理线程并行执行，蓝紫黄色块分别代表专家、门控、注意力层。
